# NC Firework

> > Professional pyrotechnics services and products by Kevin Wetzel, specializing in the Wetzel Binary System, fireworks displays, and special effects for NC and Virginia.

NC Firework (Wetzel Pyrotechnics) provides licensed pyrotechnic services including fireworks displays, flame effects, pyromusicals, and wedding services. The company offers specialized products like the Wetzel Binary System and conducts PGI Display Operators training courses in compliance with NFPA 1123 and Federal Explosives License requirements.

## Key Topics

- Kevin Wetzel
- Wetzel Binary System
- Pyrotechnics Guild International (PGI)
- Federal Explosives License (FEL)
- NFPA 1123
- Pyromusicals
- Flame effects
- Special effects
- Binary explosives
- Professional fireworks displays
- Wedding fireworks
- Display Operators Course
- DMX control systems
- Part 107 drone operations
- North Carolina and Virginia services
